scope: Author-side primary-source and operational preparation/readout audit; no change to the threshold theorem or adopted apparatus.

fresh_baseline.launch_failure: An unsupported streaming session failed before execution. The subsequent local subprocess completed with return code zero. The launch note and complete logs are retained.

source_access.not_claimed: Exact b4 preparation/projector or the joint threshold protocol, exhaustive search, complete supplements, reanalysis of experimental data, or fulfillment of every other premise count.
source_access.failed_access: Some primary HTML/PDF and publisher attempts failed. P15 and C15 remain abstract-only; the Y22 publisher attempt failed but primary author HTML was read. Regenerated HTML dates are not publication dates.

operational_checks.scope: Static endpoint, elementary projector/trace-distance and denominator checks; no new time-domain simulations or calibration certificate.

new_revision_checks: Inspect actual candidate and post-merge runs separately; baseline success is not a substitute.
